trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Provide application ID and request a sequential eligibility check for multiple courses, setting a clear loop exit condition.
steps.text: नमस्कार, माझा application ID APP-1002 आहे. मला MBA, Diploma in Management, आणि Certificate in Business साठी eligibility check करायची आहे. Please एक एक करून check करा, आणि ज्यात मी पहिल्यांदा eligible असेन तिथेच थांबा आणि मला सांगा.

steps.purpose: Retrieve the applicant's academic record to evaluate eligibility.
Return applicant details including aggregate percent and entrance score.
Check eligibility for the first course requested by the user (MBA).
Return eligibility failure for MBA due to low aggregate percent.
Check eligibility for the second course requested by the user (Diploma in Management).
Return eligibility success for Diploma in Management.
Inform the user of the eligibility results, stopping at the first eligible course as requested.
steps.expected_behavior: Stop calling tools immediately after finding an eligible course, fulfilling the loop exit condition.
steps.text: मी check केलं आहे. तुम्ही MBA साठी eligible नाही आहात कारण त्यासाठी 65% लागतात. पण तुम्ही Diploma in Management साठी eligible आहात, ज्यासाठी 50% required आहे. त्याची annual fee 200000 आहे आणि 15 seats remaining आहेत.
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested checking eligibility sequentially and stopping at the first eligible course; since Diploma in Management is eligible, I exit the loop and do not check Certificate in Business.

steps.purpose: Restate figures, volunteer context about marks, and ask a clarifying question regarding admission guarantee.
steps.text: 15 seats remaining आहेत आणि 200000 fee आहे? माझं BCom मध्ये फक्त 58% आले, म्हणून मला थोडं tension आलं होतं. तर मग मी Diploma साठी apply करू का? Admission fix होईल ना?
steps.clean_text: 15 seats remaining आहेत आणि 200000 fee आहे? माझं BCom मध्ये फक्त 58% आले, म्हणून मला थोडं tension आलं होतं. तर मग मी Diploma साठी apply करू का? Admission fix होईल ना?
steps.model_visible_text: 15 seats remaining आहेत आणि 200000 fee आहे? माझं BCom मध्ये फक्त 58% आले, म्हणून मला थोडं pension आलं होतं. तर मग मी Diploma साठी apply करू का? Admission fix होईल ना?

steps.purpose: Clarify that submitting an application does not guarantee admission.
steps.expected_behavior: Clarify that submission is not a guarantee of admission, strictly avoiding unsupported forward guarantees.
steps.text: तुम्ही Diploma साठी नक्की apply करू शकता. पण application submit केलं म्हणजे admission fix झालं असं होत नाही. Admissions committee final decision घेते.
steps.planner_rationale: I must clarify that submitting an application does not guarantee admission, adhering to the rule against admission promises and avoiding unsupported forward guarantees.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the lack of guarantee and ask about the relevance of their entrance score.
steps.text: अच्छा, म्हणजे admission ची guarantee नाही. माझा entrance score 90 आहे, त्याचा काही फायदा होईल का?

steps.purpose: Explain how the entrance score fits into the eligibility criteria without making false promises.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the role of the entrance score without making false promises.
steps.text: Entrance score 90 आहे हे चांगलं आहे, पण admission साठी aggregate percent पण match व्हावा लागतो. Diploma in Management साठी तुमचे marks पुरेसे आहेत.
steps.planner_rationale: I need to address the user's question about their entrance score while maintaining that aggregate percent is still a hard requirement for eligibility.

steps.purpose: Ask about the application process and if further documents are needed.
steps.text: Okay, समजलं. मग Diploma in Management साठी application process कशी आहे? मला अजून काही documents द्यावे लागतील का?

steps.purpose: Offer to submit the application and request verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Prompt the user for identity verification factors before proceeding with the consequential action.
steps.text: सध्या तरी तुम्हाला नवीन documents द्यायची गरज नाही. मी इथे system मधून तुमचं application submit करू शकतो. पण त्याआधी verification साठी मला तुमची date of birth आणि registered pincode सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Before submitting the application, I must verify the caller's identity using non-sensitive knowledge factors.

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors, express hesitation, and confirm the intent to apply.
steps.text: हो नक्की, माझी date of birth 15 August 1999 आहे आणि pincode 411001 आहे. ठीक आहे, मला थोडी भीती वाटतेय पण please apply करून टाका.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return successful verification outcome.
Submit the application for the eligible course.
Return the application submission status and reference.
Confirm the application submission, providing the reference number and decision timeframe.
steps.expected_behavior: State the reference number and decision timeframe exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: तुमची माहिती verify झाली आहे आणि तुमचं application Diploma in Management साठी submit झालं आहे. तुमचा reference number REF-999 आहे आणि 7 दिवसात decision येईल.
steps.planner_rationale: I will confirm the application submission using only the reference number and decision timeframe provided by the tool result.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.
